messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["axolotl", "pangolin"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A stout quadrupedal animal shown in right-facing profile with pale pinkish-gray wrinkled skin on the head, underside, and limbs and a long tapering tail. The head is broad and flat with a blunt snout, small dark eyes, and a wide mouth. Behind the head on both sides are multiple long pinkish stalks bearing dense reddish feathery filaments. The torso is low-slung with four short thick limbs ending in splayed clawed toes. The entire dorsal surface from behind the head to the tip of the tail is covered in neat overlapping rows of rounded brown glossy scales, while the throat, belly, and underside of the tail are pale and transversely wrinkled.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "broad flat smooth pale pinkish-gray with dark speckling, blunt rounded snout, tiny nostril, wide slightly smiling mouth", "part": "head", "where": "at the front right end of the body"}, {"looks_like": "small round dark eyes with pale blue-gray iris and black pupil", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head, one clearly visible on the near side"}, {"looks_like": "long pinkish stalks with dense reddish feathery filaments along one edge", "part": "gills", "where": "protruding outward and upward from just behind the head on both sides of the neck"}, {"looks_like": "short thick fleshy limbs with wrinkled folded pale skin", "part": "legs", "where": "under the torso, two front legs under the chest and two hind legs under the mid-body"}, {"looks_like": "broad splayed feet with four to five short blunt clawed toes", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of each leg touching the ground"}, {"looks_like": "long tapering laterally flattened structure, pale below, fully scaled above, ending in a rounded point", "part": "tail", "where": "extending from the rear of the torso to the left"}, {"looks_like": "overlapping rounded brown keratinous plates with glossy centers and fine striations, arranged in longitudinal rows", "part": "scales", "where": "covering the entire back from behind the gills to the tip of the tail"}, {"looks_like": "pale pinkish-white soft skin with transverse wrinkles and folds and faint dark speckling on the head", "part": "skin", "where": "on the throat, underside of torso and tail, and the limbs"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
